notes:
Asking to trim several clips no longer starts a render instead.

'trim all the clips to 10s' and 'trim both clips to 10s' used to plan a full GPU upscale — not a polite decline, an expensive render of footage you had just asked to shorten. 'trim the clips to 10s', one word shorter, worked fine. Quantifiers now count as part of what you're pointing at.
